FULL BATHROOM RENOVATIONS · FIFE

Rethink the whole room.

A full renovation is the chance to improve the layout as well as replace the suite. Plan the plumbing, storage and finishing work together.

Discuss your project ↗See our work

PLAN THE WORK

A clear plan before the old suite comes out.

Start with what does not work in the current bathroom. Is the shower cramped? Is there too little storage? Would moving the toilet make better use of the space? A useful brief explains the problem, not just the style you like.

A complete renovation may involve removal, pipework changes, wall preparation and several finishing trades. Ask for a quote that sets out which tasks are included, who carries them out and what you need to supply.

Existing conditions can affect the plan once fittings are removed. Discuss how any extra work would be explained and agreed before it goes ahead.

THINGS TO DISCUSS

Make the brief clear.

  • Layout and plumbing requirements
  • Removal and preparation scope
  • Suite and fitting choices
  • Finishing trades and handover

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

How long will a renovation take?

The programme depends on the size of the room, alterations, product availability and the agreed trades. Ask for a schedule for your specific project.

Should I order a suite first?

Have the dimensions and plumbing requirements checked before you commit to products, especially when changing the layout.
